# Math 11 — Slides

Student-facing slide decks for **Math 11, Elementary Statistics** at
California State University, Fresno.

Open `index.html` to browse the decks. Each deck is a single self-contained
HTML file: it makes no external requests, works offline, reflows on a phone,
carries its own dark-mode toggle, and meets WCAG 2.1 AA.

## This repository is build output

**Do not edit these files here.** They are generated from the FSMath wiki by
the `accessible-slides` skill and copied in by `scripts/publish.mjs`. A fix
belongs in FSMath; re-publishing overwrites whatever is in this directory.
